title: Token bucket and per-key limiter
spec: Implement TokenBucket and Limiter as their doc comments say, with integer milli-token arithmetic: refill_per_sec tokens a second is refill_per_sec milli-tokens a millisecond, capped at capacity * 1000. Use saturating arithmetic. Replace the `_todo` fields (a HashMap<K, TokenBucket> for Limiter). No new dependencies.
